I spent some time on Jiabo's genomic selection model, however, I was stagnated on the missing of some important values. The new model combined with the GWAS result as fixed effect requires some extra information.

The first issue is pseudo QTL determination. That can be simply determined by using the same standard we used in GWAS analysis. I directly used -log P value higher than 4 to screen out all SNPs as pseudo QTL.

I suggest if you use higher values like 5 instead of 4 so you will only pick up those very significant QTL.

The second issue is to filter out the genotype of those SNPs. That can be done easily, while it will be used as CV(covariance), therefore we must know the favorable allele source to assign the genotype of each SNP. Because it uses numeric format, we have to make sure the consistency of the number that represents a favorable allele (2 favorable, 0 unfavorable, 1 heterozygous). However, the favorable allele didn't show in any model except MLM. Therefore, I can't make progress without that information in the BLINK model. Re: FarmCPU on correlated traits

user001

The results make sense in general. GLM tests markers one at a time without fitting associated markers as covariates. Consequently, GLM generates similar results for highly correlated traits. FarmCPU is the opposite which incorporates associated markers as covariates. As the covariates may be different. The p values of markers could be very different, especially for the ones that are not significant. FarmCPU calculates P values of covariate markers differently from the non-covariate markers, which adds another dimension of variation. For a pair of markers in 100% of LD, their p values are very different. If you are using a linkage-like population, this could be the reason that the two associate markers on CHR 10 are not the same. I guess the associated markers on CHR1 are identical for the two traits. Did you find this marker with GLM? I am user001 Xiaolei Liu (the first author of FarmCPU) and user001 ( the current leading author of GAPIT). GAPIT implemented a lot of models. You are welcome to validate your analyses there.

主题: Re: 咨询GAPIT软件不同模型得到的结果差异

这两个方法都是多位点模型，因此会把一段区域内最显著的位点P值更显著，而其他位点的P值变大，因此曼哈顿图就不是连续的点。这种关联性肯定是没问题的，如果是找基因的话，可能还得辅助LD 图形来确定。
GAPIT支持缺失值，基因型是hapmap的可以，但是数值型的不支持。表型文件中可以有缺失值，用NA来表示。
至于基因型文件和表型文件匹配的问题，GWAS中肯定是会做过滤的，把能匹配的留下做分析。而在基因组选择中会对没有表型的个体进行预测表型。

德鹏，你好，
很高兴和你讨论GAPIT和统计遗传相关的研究问题。
1 在GWAS中表型的确实，在计算模型中会直接被剔除掉，所以放与不放都是一样的。
2 在GAPIT中，GS和GWAS是分两步进行计算的，整个模型都是有区别的。在GS中，预测BLUP是通过混合线性模型的求解，利用所有个体间的亲缘关系矩阵来推算的。一般来讲这种个体表型缺失，不会用来进行GWAS分析，因为BLUP值是通过已知群体进行预测的，如果使用BLUP作为表型，会降低性状的环境残差，把已知表型群体的基因效应放大，这样筛选出来的结果具有很大的迷惑性。因此不建议使用。
3 、4 多年，多环境的表型性状可以用BLUP值来计算，因为属于同一个性状在不同环境的表现，可以用BLUP值来降低环境在遗传中的作用，增强探测纯加性遗传效应的power。如果性状受到环境影响很大，那这里面存在很强的互作，我们新作了一个软件，GbyE，是专门解决这种情况的，你可以试试，在www.zzlab.net/GbyE，这个软件目前只支持mac系统，文章也没有发出来，所以只能简单测试使用。目前还没有开发windows和linux系统的。
5 表型值异常值处理，这个得具体考虑到你表型值的具体分布，比如假设是正态分布，那如果有一个表型值与这个分布存在十分显著的差异，那就应该酌情剔除。当然如果个体数目十分稀少，不足以构成统计学分布，那就没办法进行筛选了，简单的那3倍标准差去考量有失偏颇。有些性状的真实分布可能和我们估计的完全不同，我们拿到的材料可能只是真实分布的一个侧面。
